verdict.rationale: Gecko offers a 'hybrid' deployment where the scanner, S3 storage, and AI inference run inside the customer's own AWS account, but Gecko itself continues to host the dashboard, database, and scan orchestration — so the core product is not fully self-hostable, only partially. Missing for 10: a fully self-hosted/on-prem deployment option (dashboard, DB, orchestration included), independent confirmation of the hybrid mode working in practice, and clarity on what 'core' functionality remains cloud-dependent.
